hero.title:
Don't act alone.

Let's be superheroes

together.
hero.subtitle: Find climate and sustainability projects that need your skills, or bring your own idea and let collaborators help you make it real.

entry.browseDesc: Filter by skill, location, time commitment. Find one that fits and join in.
entry.dashboardDesc: Pinned projects, next steps, and what's happening on the projects you've joined.
entry.signInDesc: Returning? Pick up where you left off. New here? Create an account in under a minute.
entry.signInDescSignedIn: You're signed in. Head to your dashboard to see your projects.

projects.title: New projects looking for you.
projects.subtitle: Just launched, and in need of their first contributors. Steps usually take less than 2 hours.

how.title: Contribute as much, or as little, as your time allows.
how.step1Desc: Add the things you're good at, and the ones you actually want to use on a project. A burnt-out developer doesn't have to do coding.
how.step2Desc: Browse whole projects, or just single steps. The smallest unit can be a 30-minute task, perfect for a quiet evening.
how.step3Desc: Join the team, claim a step, and ship something real with people who care about the same thing you do.

cta.title: Ready to act?
cta.subtitle: Browse what's live right now, or sign in to see your dashboard.

waitlist.title: Be the first to know when projects go live.
waitlist.subtitle: We're bringing the first organisations and projects onto the platform now. Leave your e-mail and we'll tell you as soon as there's something you can join. No account needed.
waitlist.label: Your e-mail address
waitlist.fineprint: By signing up you agree to receive e-mails about The Superhero. See our <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
waitlist.consentText: By signing up you agree to receive e-mails about The Superhero.

success.title: You're on the list.
success.body: Check your inbox to confirm your address. We'll be in touch as soon as the first projects are ready for you.

confirmed.title: You're all set.
confirmed.body: Thanks for confirming. We'll e-mail you the moment the first projects are ready to join.

already.title: Already confirmed.
already.body: Your address was already on the list — nothing more to do. We'll be in touch soon.

invalid.title: This link has expired.
invalid.body: That confirmation link is no longer valid. Sign up again from the home page and we'll send a fresh one.

unsubscribed.title: You've been unsubscribed.
unsubscribed.body: You won't receive any more launch e-mails from us. You can sign up again any time.

confirm.preview: Confirm your e-mail to join The Superhero launch list.
confirm.subject: Confirm your e-mail — The Superhero
confirm.heading: One quick step to go
confirm.p1: Thanks for your interest in The Superhero. Please confirm this is your address so we can tell you when the first projects are ready to join.
confirm.p2: If you didn't sign up, you can safely ignore this e-mail — nothing will happen.
confirm.why: You're getting this because someone entered this address on thesuperhe.ro.

broadcast.why: You're getting this because you signed up to hear when The Superhero launched.
